rule_text.name: 701.78a
rule_text.rule: Abound is a keyword action. “Abound” means “You may cast a spell from your hand with a lesser mana value than this spell or permanent without paying its mana cost.”

rule_text.name: 701.78b
rule_text.rule: If an triggered or activated ability instructs you to abound, use the mana value of the source of that ability to determine the mana value. If the ability somehow doesn't have a source, its mana value is 0 and you will be unable to cast a spell with a lesser mana value.
